m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Please forgive us for the delay, Exalted One. Our third dancer is here now. As soon as she takes her position, we will begin the performance.
Take your time, Drifter. Business has been... trying of late. Ali Baboon simply wishes to relax and enjoy the show.
Psst! Hurry up! Just do your best, and don't forget to shake your hips!
Well done. Your Dromel Dancers are very talented, and so lovely too, especially the third one.
Indeed, take your other two dancers and leave. I'd like the third one to remain behind for a solo performance.
Um... Thank you, of course, Mister Baboon. I hope we can perform for you again some time...
Sorry, my friend. I hope this goes well. We will await you out in the Main Hall.
My, my. Here I thought I left all my troubles behind in Aggrobah. I am surprised. I didn't expect to see you again, certainly not so soon.
Come now, you didn't actually think Ali Baboon would be fooled by a disguise? Such tricks will not work on me. I am not a Walrusk Empress.
But the good news is that Ali Baboon is always up for more entertainment. Perhaps you failed to notice - you're standing on a trap door...
Look who dropped in! When I said "break a leg", I meant it as a figure of speech, you know? So, we both got made. Bit of a bummer, isn't it?
Things could be worse, though, right? I mean, for one thing, being dropped down in a hole can be lonely. At least we have each other, yeah?
It seems Ali Baboon is already waiting for us in his Audience Chamber, and he's anticipating three dancers, not just two.
Believe me, if there was any way out of this, I'd take it. I know it might seem awkward, but follow us in and just... just dance.
Oops! Forgot my dancing shoes! Not like I'd need them, I suppose, but I'd give us away anyhow. I'll stay out here. You go on. Break a leg!
